markdown:
## Administration in the 2008 program guide

The Office of Elementary and Secondary Education (OESE), within the U.S. Department of Education, administered Reading First. This identifies the federal office in the historical guide; it does not identify every local delivery organization.

## Grants and local implementation

State education agencies received formula grants. Eligible local education agencies applied to states for competitive subgrants. These grant recipients are distinct from the federal administering office and from the funded and comparison schools in the impact evaluation.

## Funding and comparison limits

National appropriations and anticipated awards are program funding measures. They are not measured delivery costs per student or costs matched to the evaluation's estimated impacts, and cannot serve as cost-effectiveness denominators.

## Source

[Guide to U.S. Department of Education Programs 2008](https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED502979.pdf), printed p. 155 (PDF page 181).
